Sarath Search Engine v4.0 User Privacy, Terms, & Compliance Statements

Privacy First Search Standard

At Sarath Search, privacy is built directly into our core architecture. We do not sell your personal data, track your cross-site web activity, or expose precise geolocation information.

Our Privacy Guarantees:

  • Zero third-party advertising trackers or behavioral profiling.
  • Location permissions requested explicitly via browser prompt with full user consent.
  • All queries encrypted via TLS 1.3 in transit and stored safely under RLS policies.
